title: Loading screen

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot illustrated hand-painted fantasy game UI art. Restrained antique brass/gold, weathered dark wood and root details, deep blue-teal recesses, moss green and warm cream highlights. Selective crisp readable edges and soft painted material shading, elegant low-ornament UI suited to small screens. No characters, text, letters, numbers, interface labels, mockup boards, screenshots, gridlines, watermarks or drop shadows. One opaque WIDE16:9 landscape loading-screen background illustration,1536x864or larger. A quiet woodland path through vast twisted roots toward distant ancient blue-gray ruins; warm small lantern light at lowerleft against soft cool teal depth. No visible people, creatures, questobjects or specialstoryscene. Keep CENTER and BOTTOM QUARTER spacious, low detail and low contrast for later dynamic loading label/progress bar/tip text; keep important visual features away from outer10% so widescreen cover-cropping is safe. Cohesive full-canvas image, no panels, logos or baked loading widgets. Ambient storytelling illustration only.
